jobs.title: Staff GNC Engineer – Flight Controls
jobs.description_text: About the Role The GNC team at Pivotal develops the flight control and navigation algorithms that let our aircraft fly safely and precisely, including on the Helix family of aircraft. We are looking for a Staff GNC Engineer to lead flight control law development on an aircraft program: owning the control law architecture and its design, tuning, and verification from simulation through flight test. You will set the technical direction for how our aircraft are controlled in hover, transition, and forward flight. That includes defining the control law architecture and design criteria, using system identification and flight data to improve our models, and making sure the control laws meet stability, performance, and handling qualities requirements. You will also be a team lead for flight controls, setting priorities for the team, overseeing its technical work, and mentoring the engineers on it, while working closely with the navigation, firmware, aeromechanical, systems engineering, safety, and flight test teams. The ideal candidate has a track record of taking flight control laws from design to flight on real aircraft, ideally VTOL, rotorcraft, or eVTOL, and the judgment to make sound design and flight test decisions with incomplete information. This role is a strong next step for an engineer who has grown through hands-on flight controls work and is ready to lead a team.

jobs.description_text: Position Summary Applied Controls is seeking a Sr. Electrical Design & Controls Engineer to support the design, programming, integration, and commissioning of custom automation, robotics, vision, and industrial control systems. This position is responsible for electrical system design, controls programming, hardware selection, documentation development, and startup support throughout the project lifecycle. The ideal candidate combines strong electrical design skills with hands-on controls engineering experience and is capable of taking ownership of both electrical and controls deliverables for automation projects. Prior department leadership experience is a plus. Primary Responsibilities Electrical Design & Documentation • Develop electrical schematics, panel layouts, wiring diagrams, and documentation packages using EPLAN. • Design industrial control systems including PLCs, HMIs, motion control systems, robotic systems, machine safety systems, and industrial networking. • Create electrical bills of materials (BOMs) and support component procurement activities. • Select and specify electrical components. • Generate manufacturing documentation packages for panel fabrication, machine assembly, installation, and customer deliverables. • Maintain and improve company electrical design standards and best practices. Controls Engineering • Develop PLC, HMI, and motion control software for custom automation systems. • Configure industrial communication networks including Ethernet/IP,

jobs.title: Product Manager, Xsolla Ads
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU The Xsolla Offerwall puts rewarded offers in front of players inside the games and apps of our publishers. A player opens the wall, picks an offer, completes it, and earns in-game currency. Whether they do depends on what they see: the offer card, the creative, the video, the playable, and the reward moment. Those units come from several places. Some are native offers we render ourselves. Some arrive as VAST video, HTML or MRAID creatives, or OpenRTB Native assets from demand partners. Each format has its own rules, and each one has to look right in a publisher's game, on a phone, without breaking what the advertiser sent. You'll own how offerwall ads look and perform. You'll decide which formats we support and how they render. You'll design what the player sees, and turn that into specs engineers can build from. Because we own and operate our vehicles, supply is fixed in the short run, and these levers are how we trade growth against profit week to week. Dynamic pricing — the real-time engine that balances a fixed fleet against live demand, weighing growth against profit market by market. Promotions and incentives — from promo mechanics and budget planning through targeted, personalized incentives as the rider base grows. Fleet supply — how many vehicles are in service each hour and where they stage and charge, so fleet and pricing decisions optimize against the same objectives.
